description: Implementation of the LightSensor class for handling ambient light sensor data on Android, including sensor enabling/disabling, setting delay, reading sensor events, and converting ADC values to lux.

classes.name: LightSensor
classes.description: Handles ambient light sensor operations including enabling/disabling, setting delay, reading events, and converting ADC values to lux.

methods.name: LightSensor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sensor, setting up input path, and enabling the sensor.

methods.name: ~LightSensor
methods.description: Destructor disabling the sensor if enabled.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the polling delay for the sensor.

methods.name: hasPendingEvents
methods.description: Checks if there are pending sensor events.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Reads sensor events, processes input events, and outputs light level data.

methods.name: indexToValue
methods.description: Converts ADC index to lux value based on predefined ranges.
